“If thieves came to you, if robbers by night—oh, what disaster awaits you—wouldn’t they only steal until they had…
How Esau will be ransacked! How his hidden treasures are sought out!

parallels.note: “If thieves came to you, if robbers by night—oh, what disaster awaits you—wouldn’t they only steal until they had…

translations.web: If grape gatherers came to you, would they not leave some gleaning grapes? If thieves came by night, wouldn’t they steal until they had enough?
translations.bsb: If grape gatherers came to you, would they not leave some gleanings? Were thieves to come in the night, would they not steal only what they wanted?
translations.kjv: If grapegatherers come to thee, would they not leave some gleaning grapes? if thieves by night, they will destroy till they have enough.
translations.asv: If grape-gatherers came to thee, would they not leave some gleaning grapes? if thieves by night, would they not destroy till they had enough?
